records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Media
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project reached day 0 (2026-07-10) then no activity for 6 days; no invites, no tickets, and three Wrenfield emails [email:477991ef], [email:8a111927], [email:9f3f3e4e] drew zero customer reply. Silent, disengaged admin with 8 days left makes unaided key_milestone unlikely, though Pro plan and early project give some chance.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Following up on my last note — you've got your first project set up, which is the main thing: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

The usual next step is getting a colleague in alongside you; a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next for Union Media and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Priya
